Method of Attack: The ransomware executable contains an embedded encrypted C# program that is decrypted and compiled at runtime using CSharpCodeProvider, then launched directly into memory to perform ransomware functionality.
Encrypts files on victim's computer and renames them using the template sequre@tuta.io_[hex].
Saves the decryption key and IV to a file on the desktop.
Creates ransom note named HOW DECRIPT FILES.hta in each folder scanned.
Indicators of Compromise: Encrypted files renamed with sequre@tuta.io_[hex] pattern
Ransom note named HOW DECRIPT FILES.hta
